items.title: Boy, We Were Wrong About SpaceX
items.summary: Shortly before SpaceX’s record-setting IPO, we called SpaceX stock worth $90 a share.  Before that, we said that SpaceX was the big loser in its February merger with xAI.  Now, it looks as if SpaceX shareholders were the winners in the xAI deal and that while SpaceX is still hard to value, it’s worth far more than $90 a share.
